ourStory.title: Our Story
ourStory.text: We came from different worlds, but somehow, in the middle of Romania, everything just clicked. From our first conversation, there was an ease between us—a spark that grew into countless shared moments, late-night talks, and adventures exploring life together. We've laughed through the chaos, supported each other through challenges, and built a love that feels like home. After years of growing together, we're ready to say "I do." We're grateful to have you be part of our journey, and we can't wait to celebrate with the people who mean the most to us.
